## 7.1 Players and devices

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Worldwide, about seven in ten phones run Android.
- The share is different in each country, so we check it with its date.
- Android runs on many makers and models, and iOS on a few iPhones.
- **Do it:** Count the Android phones and the iPhones in your family. Is the share near 70 / 30?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/reach-devices.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 1 · Players and devices

a) About how many phones in ten run Android worldwide?
b) What does fragmentation mean for a tester?
c) Why do we look at the share of one country?

::: {.answer}
a) about seven
b) many models and versions to test
c) Players differ from country to country.
:::

## 7.2 Building and testing

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Android Studio runs on Windows, macOS and Linux.
- Xcode runs only on a Mac, so an iOS build needs a Mac.
- Android needs more real test phones than iOS.
- **Do it:** Plan a launch on both in Launch Planner with only Windows PCs. What is the problem?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/build-test.png)
:::
::::

## Example · Byte Bay's computers

Byte Bay has five Windows PCs and no Mac.
**Which builds can the studio make, and on which phones does it test?**

::: {.reveal}
1. The **Android** build is possible today, on any of the PCs.
2. The **iOS** build waits until the studio buys or rents a Mac.
3. It tests on P5, P6 and P7 for Android, and on two iPhones for iOS.
:::

## Try it 2 · Build and test

a) On which computer can Xcode run?
b) Byte Bay has only Windows PCs. Which build can it make?
c) Why are virtual phones on the PC not enough for testing?

::: {.answer}
a) only on a Mac
b) the Android build
c) A virtual phone has no real battery, heat or weak chip.
:::

## 7.3 Open or closed

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Android is open, and apps can come from other stores or an .apk file.
- iOS is closed, and apps come mainly from the App Store.
- Android updates come from each maker, but Apple updates all iPhones at once.
- **Do it:** Find "Install unknown apps" on an Android phone. Which apps may install other apps?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/openness.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 3 · Open or closed?

a) Which platform installs an .apk file from outside the store?
b) Which platform updates every supported phone at the same time?
c) Why does a tester still test on an old Android version?

::: {.answer}
a) Android
b) iOS
c) Many phones never get the newest version.
:::

## 7.4 Facts you can trust

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- We choose the criteria of a comparison for the decision we must make.
- A reliable source has a known author, a date and its data.
- The best source for a fact about a platform is the maker's own page.
- **Do it:** Judge the five sources in Source Check. Which three signs did you use?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/criteria-sources.png)
:::
::::

{{< sim file="sims/source-check.html" poster="sims/source-check.png" title="Source Check: can you trust this source?" task="**Show:** tick the signs of source 1 (Apple's page about Xcode) and use it, then skip source 2 (a forum post). **Ask:** which sign is missing in the forum post?" >}}

## Example · Three sources for one fact

Rami needs the share of Android phones in the country of his players.
**Which of three sources does he use?**

::: {.reveal}
1. A market report with its data, updated last month, is **reliable**: he writes the month.
2. A blog from 2019 is **too old** and shows no data.
3. A forum post has **no author and no date**, so he cannot check it.
:::

## Try it 4 · Sources

a) Which source is best for the fact that Xcode runs only on a Mac?
b) A forum post has no author and no date. Does Rami use it?
c) Why does a market share in a table need its date?

::: {.answer}
a) Apple's developer page, with this year's date
b) No, he finds a better source.
c) Shares change from month to month.
:::

## Try it 5 · Advice (harder)

The facts: an iOS build needs a Mac. Android reaches about 7 in 10 phones worldwide, and iOS about 3 in 10.

a) Which platform should a studio with only Windows PCs and budget-phone players choose first?
b) Which platform fits a studio with a Mac whose players mostly have iPhones?
c) What should a studio with a Mac and players all over the world choose?

::: {.answer}
a) Android first
b) iOS first, or both
c) both platforms
:::

## Summary

- Android reaches more phones worldwide, but each country is different.
- Android builds on any PC, and iOS needs a Mac.
- Android needs more test phones because of fragmentation.
- Android is open and updated by each maker, and iOS by Apple.
- A fact goes into a comparison only with a reliable source and its date.
